mapper.select: select sowing_id, ground_id, seed_quantity, sowing_method, sowing_time, create_time, update_time from sowing_info where ground_id = #{groundId} and is_deleted = 0 order by sowing_time
mapper.update: update sowing_info set is_deleted = 1 where ground_id = #{groundId}
mapper.insert:
insert into sowing_info (sowing_id, ground_id, seed_quantity, sowing_method, sowing_time, create_time) values
(#{item.sowingId}, #{item.groundId}, #{item.seedQuantity}, #{item.sowingMethod}, #{item.sowingTime}, #{item.createTime})
